Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 8+.)
1+ | At the beginning of combat on your turn, put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or two charge counters on up to one other target artifact.
8+ | Flying

needs.what: Station symbols (721) on triggered and static/keyword abilities: a `threshold: {counter: charge, at_least: N}` that makes the permanent HAVE a triggered ability (1+ begin-combat trigger) or a keyword (8+ Flying) only at N+ charge counters, plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T only at its highest station threshold (8+) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (loader _compile_threshold refuses others); a trigger `condition` or static `condition` on counters would leave the ability on the permanent, which the packet notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 5/5 artifact creature at 8+ -- a counters-conditioned set_types static would be an invented approximation of rule 721 rather than the station mechanic
